title: PhasesFile
description:
`phases.yaml`: the pilot's options, the stages and phases of a flight with the lists in
each phase, the turnaround rule and the Start page's order.

options.description: The choices the pilot makes that `show_if` tests read.

phases.description: Every phase, flight and reference, with its lists.

stages.description: The stages of a flight, in order, as the rail shows them.

start_page.description:
The Start page's order: the ids of options asked there, and `panel_state` for the
panel-state picker. Without it, the options in this file's order, then the picker.

turnaround.description:
Which option choices make a turnaround, for steps in Essentials only on a turnaround
(`quick: turnaround`). Required when any step uses it.

FieldId.description:
A flight field's id, e.g. `zfw`: one of the fields the pack defines in `flight.yaml`
(decision 0029), or one of the app's own, [`FieldId::MANUAL`] and [`FieldId::ROUTE_LEG`].
Saved flights key their values by it, as text.

IntroParagraph.description: One paragraph of a phase's introduction.

heading.description: A short lead-in shown before the text, e.g. "When to use them".

OptionChoice.description: How one value of an option is shown, e.g. "Ground power at the gate".

description.description: A line shown under the label.

label.description: The text shown for the value.

value.description: The option value it shows: one of the option's `values`.

OptionTest.description: One test against a pilot-chosen option. The options are declared by the pack.

anyOf.description: Passes when the option has this value.
Passes when the option has one of these values.

one_of.description: The values, any one of which passes.

Phase.description: One part of the flight, holding its lists in order.

engine_start.description:
The phase that starts the engines, on at most one flight phase: Practice's "Before
engine start" covers the flight up to and including it.

group.description:
Which reference group the phase is, required on a reference phase: `memory` (memory
items), `quick` (quick reference) or `procedures` (non-normal procedures). The app
reads reference phases by group, never by their order or title (decision 0029).

id.description: Unique in the pack: stages, `ask_in`, links and other files name the phase by it.

intro.description: Shown at the top of the phase.

lists.description: Ids of the lists in this phase.

reference.description: Reference material, outside the normal flow of a flight.

title.description: The phase's name in the rail and at its top.

ShowIf.description:
When something is shown. Deliberately small: tests combine one level deep, with no
negation, comparisons, step state or expressions.

all_of.description: The tests, all of which must pass.

any_of.description: The tests, one of which must pass.

id.description:
Unique in the pack, and never changes once published: the rail, Find and a pack
extending this one name the stage by it (decision 0029). The title is display text.

phases.description: Its phases, in the rail's order.

title.description: The stage's name in the rail.

StagePhase.description: A phase's place in a stage.

show_if.description: Shows the phase in this stage only when the pilot's options pass this test.

StartControl.description:
An option on the Start page (decision 0029): its control style, and optionally its own
title and description there (the option's own are used otherwise) and a link to a phase.

description.description: Its description on the Start page; the option's own otherwise.

link.description: A link under it to a phase.

on.description: With `style: toggle`: the value the switch sets when on; off sets the other.

title.description: Its title on the Start page; the option's own otherwise.

StartLink.description: A link from a Start page option to a phase, e.g. "Preview the inspection".

phase.description: The id of the phase the link opens.

StartStyle.description: How the Start page draws an option: one card per choice, or a segmented row.

oneOf.description: A segmented row of the choices.
An on/off switch, for an option of two values: `on` names the value it sets when on.

SuggestLine.description: A suggestion rule's line and margin in the other unit.

more_than.description: The line, in the other unit.

near.description: How close to the line counts as close, in the other unit.

SuggestRule.description:
A weight from the flight, less `minus`, above `more_than` suggests `then`, otherwise
`otherwise`; within `near` of `more_than` the suggestion says it is close to the line
(decision 0027). The amounts are in `unit`. With `minus` at 0, nothing is suggested.

field.description: The flight field whose weight is read, e.g. the planned fuel.

minus.description:
Taken from the weight before it is compared (what other tanks hold). At 0, nothing is
suggested.

more_than.description: The line: what is left above it suggests `then`.

near.description: How close to the line the suggestion says it is close; 0 never says so.

other_unit.description:
The line and margin for a flight in the other unit, when the choices name both
("More than 1,000 lb (450 kg)"): a pound flight is held to 1,000 lb, not 992.

otherwise.description: The option value suggested when what is left is at or below the line.

then.description: The option value suggested when what is left is above the line.

unit.description:
The unit `minus`, `more_than` and `near` are in; a flight in the other unit is
converted.

Suggests.description:
What suggests an option's answer: a rule (decision 0027), or, as format 4 wrote it, a bare
flight field, which suggests nothing.

anyOf.description: A rule that suggests an answer.
A bare flight field, as format 4 wrote it: suggests nothing.

UserOption.description: A choice the pilot makes that decides what is shown, e.g. the power source.

ask_in.description: Phases that show the choice above their lists, and `start` for the Start page.

choices.description: How each value is shown. When present, every value has exactly one.

default.description: The value used until the pilot chooses. Must be one of `values`.

description.description: What the choice changes, shown beside it.

id.description:
Unique in the pack: `show_if` tests, `ask_in`, `start_page` and saved flights name
the option by it.

start.description: How the Start page shows the choice; required when `ask_in` names `start`.

suggests.description:
How a flight value suggests the answer, for the pilot to confirm (decisions 0022 and
0027).

title.description: The choice's name where it is asked; the Start page may give its own.

values.description: The values the pilot chooses among, in order. `show_if` tests compare against them.

WeightUnit.description: A unit for a suggestion rule's amounts.
